a_concept:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished full battle screen HUD concept for Close Fight, a 1942 top-down WWII tactics game. EXACT landscape canvas 1600 x 1000 pixels, 8:5 aspect, no outer presentation frame or title. Map occupies entire background: strictly overhead orthographic ruined Stalingrad city blocks, roofless brick factories, streets, rubble, small squads; muted realistic strategy-game terrain, never isometric. HUD compact and crisp with high contrast, flat implementable fills, 1px borders, NO glow, blur, bevels, heavy gradients, fake rivets, torn paper, wood, decorative emblems. NO national/political symbols, swastikas, eagles, iron crosses, stars, flags anywhere, including unit portraits and map. Use small neutral geometric objective circles. One font family Noto Sans SC Regular 400/Medium 500/Semibold 600/Bold 700, 11-14px at 1600x1000, Chinese primary with German unit names. No giant typography.
Strict required layout at 1x coordinates:
Top full width 36px strip: 战斗时间 05:12 / 45:00; 目标点 德军 2 · 5 苏军; 全军士气 with green bar 82%; right buttons 支援 12, 照明弹 3, 请求停火, English, 暂停. All fit same row.
Roster at (12,48): two adjacent narrow columns each 224px wide, 8px gutter. Left column shows 5 platoons: Kompanietrupp, 1. Zug, 2. Zug, sMG-Zug, Granatwerfer-Zug. Right column shows 4 squads of open 1. Zug: 1. Gruppe, 2. Gruppe, 3. Gruppe, MG-Trupp. Each 224x54 row has 76x54 full-colour small painted unit picture on left, 148x24 state-coloured name bar to its right, dark 148x30 lower band with ONE small head silhouette per soldier plus compact status word. Small corner stance tag on picture 弹性 / 迟滞 / 死守. 4px vertical gap. Exactly one selected squad = 1. Gruppe, use thin accent outline ONLY on this squad. Its name bar is AMBER and lower band contains 10 tiny heads and 准撤 / 驳回 controls, because it requests retreat. Other rows show green good, yellow pinned, orange shaken, red broken, grey gone state colors with readable labels.
Selected squad panel top-right (1252,48), width336 height620: title 1. Gruppe — 步兵班; summary 伤亡 0% · 士气 68% · 被压制; delegation line 托管：弹性防御 and two tiny buttons 准撤 and 驳回. EXACTLY TEN compact personnel rows, each has rank and German name, weapon plus ammo number, a Chinese mental state, and TWO separately readable thin horizontal meters, suppression RED, morale BLUE. Use these ten: 下士班长 Friedrich Wagner / MP40 冲锋枪 · 192 / 镇定; Karl Weber / Kar98k · 60 / 镇定; Otto Fischer / MG34 · 250 / 被压制; Hans Becker / Kar98k · 45 / 被压制; Paul Hoffmann / Kar98k · 60 / 镇定; Ernst Schulz / Kar98k · 35 / 被压制; Walter Koch / Kar98k · 50 / 镇定; Heinz Bauer / Kar98k · 40 / 镇定; Kurt Richter / Kar98k · 55 / 溃逃; Franz Klein / Kar98k · 60 / 镇定. Small compact 50px rows, no portraits in personnel list.
Near top centre a narrow toast (500,52) width690 height32: 1. Zug · 1. Gruppe 请求撤退：20 秒内不驳回就自动撤.
Open right-click order menu at (760,300) width256, height454. Header 目标：建筑（3 层）. Show ALL SIXTEEN rows, 24px tall, tiny monochrome tactical line icon left, Chinese command middle, hotkey right: 移动 M; 快速移动 R; 匍匐 C; 开火 F; 区域压制 E; 烟雾 K; 防御 B; 伏击 N; 隐蔽 H; 突入建筑 G; 后撤 T; 倒车 X. 倒车 X disabled, 快速移动 R hovered. Separator then 托管：弹性防御 Z; 托管：迟滞; 托管：死守; 取消托管. Do not omit rows.
Small cursor crosshair at (610,800), nearby compact hint 移动 — 左键点目标. Keep lower third mostly open map. No bottom bar. Every required HUD element visible. All Chinese text lengths realistic; clean typography with consistent alignment.
DIRECTION A / FIELD SLATE: contemporary precise flat military command interface, crisp squared corners radius2, dense quiet hierarchy, strong readability, almost solid dark slate panels #18221F at 96%, secondary #26332D, border #52645A, text #E3E8DA, secondary #AFBCAF, warm selection #C9B478, hover #35473C, press #111A16. Status colors #49694B green, #B9A75F yellow, #B17A43 orange, #96554E red, #646963 grey. Suppression #C87569, morale #7EACBF. Daytime overcast map. No texture on UI. This is a polished contemporary tactical game HUD.
a_refine: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this finished tactical HUD concept only in the specified small areas. Preserve the entire original composition, map, all top-bar controls, Chinese typography, all sixteen menu rows, all ten personnel rows, colors and design identity. Keep landscape 1600x1000 intended output. In the upper-left roster's selected 1. Gruppe row, replace the lower band's request text with ten small head silhouettes in a narrow line above TWO tiny clearly outlined buttons labelled 准撤 and 驳回. Keep amber name bar and selection border. Do not remove the approve/refuse buttons from the right panel. Change the 3. Gruppe name bar to neutral grey, label status 阵亡, heads dim; keep all other content. No flags, stars, crosses, eagles, national or political symbols. No added decorations. Do not reframe or crop.

Sheet has neat three-column grid and generous spacing on a plain neutral backing. Tiny heading "HUD / COMPONENTS / 2×". Nothing cropped. Each component is flat and buildable with fills, thin borders, small line icons; no bevels, blur, glow, perspective, fake rivets or ornaments. NO flags (even generic flags), stars, crosses, eagles, national/political symbols. Delegate icon must be THREE CONNECTED DOTS.

1. Four same-size buttons labelled 支援 12 showing NORMAL, HOVER, PRESSED, DISABLED, with small external state labels. Normal subtle border, hover brighter fill, pressed inset accent border, disabled visibly dull.
2. Menu header 目标：建筑（3 层）; underneath normal row 移动 with tiny boots icon and M flush right; hover row 快速移动 with arrow icon and R flush right; disabled row 倒车 X; thin separator; delegation row 托管：弹性防御 Z with three-connected-nodes icon. Show crisp consistent columns.
3. Five separate name bars labelled 良好 / 被压制 / 动摇 / 溃散 / 阵亡 in respectively GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED, GREY. All five unmistakably present.
4. A bordered panel sample with title 1. Gruppe — 步兵班 and two lines of realistic Chinese and Latin text.
5. One full roster card: small full-colour painted infantry group picture left, amber name bar "1. Gruppe" right, DARK head/status band below name containing TEN tiny head silhouettes and buttons 准撤 / 驳回. State tag 弹性 on picture corner. This card should demonstrate retained structural proportions,152x108 portrait,296x48 name bar,296x60 head band.
6. Separate dark head-band sample with TEN tiny person heads and label 镇定.
7. Two thin meter samples: RED suppression labelled 压制 68%, BLUE morale labelled 士气 82%, each8px tall at2x.
8. Three small separate corner tags 弹性, 迟滞, 死守, each on the top-left corner of a small portrait crop.
9. Long slim toast near bottom: 1. Zug · 1. Gruppe 请求撤退：20 秒内不驳回就自动撤. 64px tall at2x.
10. Small cursor hint 移动 — 左键点目标.
Use component text22-28px at2x, section labels22px. Layout clean and nothing overlaps. No giant design elements. Exact control dimensions are intended design targets, present as believable UI specimens.
